name: Return to MacKinley
summary: After the scare of the giblets, "Shaky" Phillipe hands you a pouch to carry to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley. Phillipe swears the debt was always meant to be paid and adds that there is no need to get rough.

sections.title: Shaky's Plea
sections.body: Phillipe presses a pouch of payment on you for Sea Wolf. Phillipe wants MacKinley told that the debt was always meant to be repaid, and swears to it. Phillipe puts it down to getting a little drunk and losing the way, and says MacKinley will understand and that there is no need to get rough.

sections.title: Sea Wolf Hears the Tale
sections.body: MacKinley chuckles and asks how hard Phillipe shook when shown the giblets. MacKinley adds that Phillipe is so easy to read that, playing cards against Phillipe, winning comes without effort.

aliases: where do i start return to mackinley
faq.answer: "Shaky" Phillipe gives you the pouch of payment for Sea Wolf MacKinley.

faq.q: What excuse does Phillipe give for not paying?
faq.answer: Phillipe puts it down to getting a little drunk and losing the way, and swears the debt was always going to be repaid.

aliases: what comes before return to mackinley
faq.answer: This follows Scaring Shaky, where MacKinley had you frighten Phillipe with giblets.
